narration: Half of all American marriages end in divorce. And when they do, the average couple silently destroys a quarter million dollars — most of it with zero warning.
visual: Two wedding rings on dark background, one with a diamond. Red crack appears between them and the right ring slides away. '$250K' title fades in at top.

narration: Number one — legal fees. The average divorce costs fifteen thousand dollars per spouse in attorney fees alone. That's thirty thousand dollars gone before a single asset is divided.
visual: Two stacks of green cash bills on light background, labeled 'Your Fees $15,000' and 'Their Fees $15,000'. A red '$30,000 GONE' banner flies up and off screen.

narration: Number two — your retirement. Splitting a 401k takes a QDRO court order, and taxes plus early withdrawal penalties can eat up to forty percent of every dollar transferred out.
visual: Pink piggy bank on dark background cracks down the middle. Coins fall from the crack. A red '40% LOST TO TAXES' badge appears at the bottom.

narration: Number three — two households instead of one. Studies show living solo costs eighty percent more per person than shared living. Your utility bills, rent, and groceries just doubled.
visual: One house on light background splits into two smaller houses sliding apart, each labeled '$2,100/mo'. A red '80% MORE EXPENSIVE' badge springs in at the bottom.

narration: And here's the part nobody talks about — the compounding gap. Over twenty years, divorced households build two hundred and fifty thousand dollars less in net worth than married ones starting from the same point.
visual: Two diverging line chart on dark background. Green 'Together' line rises steeply, red 'After Divorce' line rises slowly. A '$250K GAP' annotation appears with a bracket.

narration: A prenup costs about twenty-five hundred dollars and can protect hundreds of thousands. Knowing the real numbers changes every conversation. Follow for more money truths they don't teach in school.
visual: Green shield with dollar sign on light background. '$2,500 PRENUP' badge springs in. Red 'FOLLOW FOR MORE' button pulses at bottom.
